english: Tsubasa-san, wanna go to karaoke\nwith everyone now?
Karaoke?
Yes! I want everyone to hear\nTsubasa-san sing.\nI want to hear 'Koi no Okehazama' again too!
...Hey, is Eve going to karaoke too?
Yes! Eve-san said she's going too.
...Hibiki, sorry, but Tsubasa and I have business.\nGo with the rest.
Business? Then it can't be helped.\nGot it, contact me if anything comes up.
//Hibiki leaves.
What's up, Laura?\nDon't tell me you're going to say you'll take me as your bride now?
I hear in Japan many change wives every three months,\nbut I'm not that flighty.
This business is serious.\nYou've noticed too, haven't you?\nHow strange the enemy's movements have been lately.
Yes... how the enemy gets ahead of us\nwherever we go.
Right. An ambush inside the cave\nwould be impossible unless our movements were completely leaked.
You're saying there's a mole?
I dislike beating around the bush.\nI suspect Eve. So\nI want the opinion of you, who were saved by Eve.
Well... Eve is my savior.\nIf I suspected her of being a spy,\nI couldn't explain why she saved me.
What about Eve fighting her own pupil who showed up in the cave,\nwithout a word of reproach?
All I can say is I don't know.\nIf Eve were the enemy, I couldn't explain\nwhy she taught us how to use the Porial either.
Which is why. Before we split up,\nRemu and I came up with a trap to test Eve.\nIt is...
//Fade to black.\n//Background: in front of Gamers
Gamers is finally getting\nback to normal, nyoo.
The renovation inconvenienced our customers, nyo!\nWe'll give great service as aftercare, nyo!
We'll win back the customers who cheated\non us with other shops, nyo...!!
//Yase arrives.
Good day. May I have a moment?
Nyo!? A blonde monster, nyo!!
Who are you calling a monster?
I-I feel like a frog stared down by a snake... no,\nlike a mouse stared down by a white weasel, nyo...
I'm Yase. I'm not scary?\nAs long as you don't resist pointlessly.
(That's definitely a lie, nyo... total liar, nyo.)
Oh? You think I'm a total liar.
I don't think that at all, nyo!\nReally, nyo!!
Let me tell you something nice.\nI absolutely hate lies and humans.
(Th-this is bad, nyo...)
//Event CG: Yase giving orders
They say liars swallow a thousand needles, right?\nI think that's too lenient.
Then... how many, nyo?
Let's see, how about being force-fed needles mouth-to-mouth\nby a thousand youkai who each swallowed a thousand needles?
That makes no sense at all, nyo!?
Shall I try it out on you?\nGo, my servants!\nSeize that liar!!
This is a brutal twist even a horror movie would pale at, nyo!!
//Battle map: Akihabara.\n//Initial deployment: allies are Dejiko, enemies are Yase.
You won't escape!
Somebody help me, nyo!!
//Tsubasa transformation movie.\n//Tsubasa and Laura appear.
Staying behind was the right call.
You who command ayakashi!\nSakimori, Kazanari Tsubasa, shall face you!
Laura! Tsubasa!\nFinish her off, nyo!!
Let me ask you two as well.\nDo you know a girl named Koto?
I do. But I don't intend to answer.
To question someone\nin such an aggressive stance;\nyou must be quite ill-mannered!
Who do you think I am?\nIf you speak of manners, kneel there and bow your head!
Talking is pointless.
Indeed!
//Battle start.\n//Koto and allies appear on turn 2.
I know Koto is here.\nTrying to hide her is useless.
And you think that means we'll hand her over?
...You know what I think? Humans really are fools!!
//Koto appears.
Tsubasa-san, Laura-san, what are you doing?
Oh, it's Yase.
Finally found you, you tomboy!
What are you doing here?
I came to bring you back.\nNow, let's return to the Mirror Capital.
Ehh!! No no, absolutely not!\nNo way.
What are you saying?\nYour place isn't here.
No way! The Mirror Capital is boring!
That's not the point.\nYou must be in the Mirror Capital.
Sorry, but no can do!
Koto...!!
Yes, that's it...\nYou're the ones who dragged Koto down a bad path!!
She's really mad, nyo...
She wears it on her face, this type.
Fine!\nI'll wipe you all out and take Koto home.\nToo late to apologize now!!
//Battle resumes.
You bastards! At it again!?
Nyo!?
//Chris transformation movie.\n//Chris appears.
Chris-chan!!
This time I'll stop you for sure!!
Wait, Chris-chan!\nWe're fighting to protect the city, y'know?
Shut up! Dragging conflict\ninto world after world!\nYou're the ones spreading the flames of war!!
Disband and go home already!
That's not it, Chris-chan!\nThe incidents happening across the worlds now\nwon't end just by going back to our own world!
Shut it!\nI'll deny that logic!
Talking won't work like this.\nThen I'll speak with this sword...!
I'll... give it a try too.
//Battle resumes.
Let's stop. I don't wanna fight Yase.
Koto, you really insist on siding with them?
They've looked after me.\nI can't be ungrateful!
(Knowing Koto's personality,\nthis approach may have been a mistake...?)
//Conversation event when Chris and Hibiki clash.
Chris-chan! Let's talk it out!
Heh! You're naive!\nThis isn't something you and I\ncan settle by talking!
Even so, I want to talk it out!
Too bad!\nI don't wanna talk!!
//Conversation event when Chris and Tsubasa clash.
Yukine, feel my sword!
Heh, you taste my bullets too!
//Conversation event when Chris and Laura clash.
It's just imitation, but I'll put into this strike...!\nMy own feelings!
I'll teach you how to get through to someone!\nThe painful way!!
//Conversation event when Chris is defeated.
Damn it! Not yet!\nI haven't gone all out yet!!
Chris-chan, listen!\nThe ones you fought might have been\nfakes of me and Tsubasa-san!
Fakes? Don't screw with me!\nThere can't be two\nof the same Symphogear!
And there's no way I'd mistake\nyour songs!
What if there's someone who can perfectly recreate\neven our songs?
Wh-what are you saying!\nNo way! Nobody like that exists!
Don't mock me!!
//Chris vanishes.
Chris-chan...
It reached her a little... let's think that.
Yeah...
//Event when Yase is defeated.
To think humans could be this capable...\nI see, no wonder Koto took a liking to you.
Won't you come with us too, Yase?
No. We're going back to the Mirror Capital.\nCome, Koto.
No.
You're such a handful...\nFine, I'll give you time to say goodbye.\nBe ready to leave by next time.
//Yase vanishes.
She's gone.\nStill, I'm surprised Yase came.
What IS that scary lady, nyo?
Yase isn't scary.\nShe's nice to me.
So what is she, nyo?
Dunno? Something really important?
That explains nothing, nyo!?
//Battle ends when all enemies are defeated.\n//Background: in front of Gamers
Phew, we somehow protected Gamers\nfrom the youkai army, nyo...
Tsubasa, lingering too long in one world\nis dangerous after all.
Yeah.
Isn't it about time\nto rendezvous at IS Academy? I wonder?
Yeah.\nIt's a bit early, but shall we head to IS Academy?
That might be nice.
Then prepare yourselves\nand gather in the top-floor warehouse at Gamers.
What about you, Dejiko-chan?
I'll see you off, nyo.\n...is what I'd like to say, nyo,\nbut I'm going to save Puchiko, nyo.
We have to find Usada-san.
I don't want that idiot Usada attacking Gamers again\nand wrecking the store, nyo!
I'll punish her thoroughly, nyo!!
//Fade to black.\n//Background: warehouse interior (something fitting), same as 016C.
Everyone's here.
Then I'll inform you of the destination change.
Huh?
What do you mean? I wonder?
Remu and I decided it\nwhen we split into two teams.
The plan is to rendezvous at IS Academy,\nbut switch to Lydian Private Music Academy right before departure.
Where's Lydian Private Music Academy, nyo?
It's the school I go to! But why?
It's a test. If we're attacked\nright after moving,\nthen that means...
Our movements are being leaked? I wonder?
Rena's right.\nWe have to confirm that.
I see. Well, let's go!
Um, could it be...?
Hm? No way...?
Let's go. Hibiki, do it.
Y-yes!!\nPorial-san! To Lydian Private Music Academy!!
//The Porial appears, and light erupts.\n//Show the player as if the group vanished, but Eve and Tsubasa remain.
...Not going?
Eve, I'm grateful to you.\nAnd I trust you.
But it's also true that there's\ncircumstantial evidence\nforcing me to suspect you...
True. I won't deny it,\nI have no complaints for Sakimori-chan,\nand I don't plan to fight you here.
So...
//Event CG: the master's secret.
...Say nothing?
Mysteries unravel when they need to.\nUntil then, shh...
I can trust you?
//Event CG off.
